item.title: Yamanashi Peaches & Grapes: Fruit Picking in Japan's Orchard — Guide
item.description: Yamanashi is Japan’s top producer of both peaches and grapes, its sun-drenched, well-drained valleys around Kofu and Katsunuma filled with orchards that open to visitors for seasonal fruit picking. Peaches ripen from around June to August, followed by grapes through late summer and autumn, including the native Koshu variety also used for wine, and many orchards offer time-limited all-you-can-eat picking sessions where visitors harvest and eat fruit straight from the vine or tree, a popular family activity that pairs naturally with the region’s wine culture.
